questions.title: Publish a brand change so documents use it
questions.summary: A change in Studio is live only after it is published. Open Studio › Publishing and publish the brand.

questions.title: Why a document still shows an old design
questions.summary: Documents keep the design they were made with. Issue it again, or make a new one, to use the published design.

questions.title: Send an invoice and get paid
questions.summary: Make the invoice, press Send: the customer gets the PDF and a pay link, and you see when they open and pay it.

questions.title: See what is paid on an invoice, and how the customer can pay
questions.summary: Open the invoice: its Payment section shows what is due, paid and left, every receipt, and each way to pay — online, a payment link to copy, your bank accounts, their own account number — and lets you record a payment.

questions.title: Pay a supplier bill, all of it or part
questions.summary: Open the bill: in its Payment section, Ask to pay (or Pay from a wallet, or Pay by provider) makes a payment request for approval. Once paid it settles the bill; the section shows it on its way, then paid.

questions.title: Pay a payroll run’s net pay to each member of staff
questions.summary: Open the approved run: its Payment section’s Ask to pay makes one payment for each member of staff, in one payment run approved once, by a provider or wallet or at the bank. Each needs an approved account in Spend › Beneficiaries.

questions.title: Pay a customer back the credit on a credit note
questions.summary: Open the posted credit note: its Payment section asks for the refund as a payment request. Once paid, the refund is recorded against the credit note by itself. A refund already paid elsewhere is recorded from there too.
questions.where: Finance › Adjustment memos › a credit note › Payment

questions.title: Record a payment a customer made
questions.summary: Open Sell › Receipts, choose who paid and the invoice it is for; part payments are fine and the invoice shows what is still owed.

questions.title: A payment link does not open for a customer
questions.summary: Check the link has not expired or been paid already, and that your payment provider is connected in Admin › Payments.

questions.title: Add a second warehouse or shop
questions.summary: Admin › Locations › Add a place. Stock, numbers and people can then be kept per place.

questions.title: Invite a colleague and choose what they may do
questions.summary: People › Members › Invite: choose their role and the places it applies to. They get an email to set their password.

questions.title: Change what a role may do
questions.summary: People › Roles: open the role and switch on what it may see and change. Only an owner can make someone an owner.

questions.title: Change your password or turn on two-step sign-in
questions.summary: Account settings: change your password, and turn on two-step sign-in so a code is emailed after your password.

questions.title: Sign out a device you do not know
questions.summary: Account settings › Where you are signed in: sign it out, then change your password.

questions.title: Choose what reaches you, and how
questions.summary: Notification settings: one switch per area and channel; open an area to change one notification. "Needs you" ones always arrive in the app.

questions.title: Stop notifications at night
questions.summary: Notification settings › Quiet hours: nothing but "Needs you" is sent in those hours; the rest waits for the morning.

questions.title: Dark mode, compact rows and the font
questions.summary: Appearance: choose Light, Dark, Black or Device, the density and the font, if your organisation lets you choose.

questions.title: Change how invoice numbers look
questions.summary: Admin › Number series: change the parts and when the count starts again. Numbers already issued keep theirs.

questions.title: Change how a document behaves
questions.summary: Admin › Document settings: each document is a set of questions (approvals, prices, what it may be made from).

questions.title: Set up VAT and other taxes
questions.summary: Tax: choose your country’s taxes and rates; each line can carry more than one tax, and the VAT return is worked out for you.

questions.title: See how much stock you have
questions.summary: Inventory › Stock levels, by place and inventory type; a count corrects it, a transfer moves it between places.

questions.title: Correct stock with a count
questions.summary: Inventory › Counts: count what is on the shelf; the difference is posted with the reason you give.

questions.title: Order from a supplier and receive the goods
questions.summary: Buy › Purchase orders: send it; when the goods arrive, receive them against the order and the bill follows.

questions.title: Pay what you owe suppliers
questions.summary: Payables › Due: see what is due and pay it alone or in a batch; the bill shows what is still owed.

questions.title: Claim an expense
questions.summary: My expenses › New claim: add the receipt and the amount; your approver is told, and you see when it is paid.

questions.title: Fill in your timesheet
questions.summary: My timesheet: enter hours per project and day, or run the timer; submit the week for approval.

questions.title: Ask for leave
questions.summary: My profile › My leave › Ask for leave: choose the days; your manager is told and you see the answer there.

questions.title: Find your payslip
questions.summary: My profile › My payslips: each month’s payslip, with take-home after PAYE and pension, to open or download.

questions.title: Something in my HR record is wrong
questions.summary: My profile › My details › Suggest a change: HR is told which field and what it should say.

questions.title: Change your plan or the features you pay for
questions.summary: Billing: an owner changes the plan or the features; the month so far, its projection and the invoices are there too.

questions.title: Something on your Clafina invoice looks wrong
questions.summary: Open the invoice and press "Ask Clafina about this invoice": say which line and why. Clafina answers in Help and credits what was wrong.

questions.title: You paid Clafina by bank transfer
questions.summary: Open the invoice and press "I have paid by transfer" with the amount, date and reference, so Clafina can match it.

questions.title: Let Clafina support look inside your account
questions.summary: Help › Support access (owners): Clafina asks with a reason; you choose how long, and every page they looked at is listed after.

questions.title: Have bills and receipts read for you
questions.summary: Capture: forward or photograph a bill; it is read and drafted for you to check before it is posted.

questions.title: Get a report by email every week
questions.summary: Reports: open the report, press Schedule, choose who receives it and when.

questions.title: Leave an organisation or close your account
questions.summary: Account settings › Leave or close your account. An owner hands over first; closing waits 14 days so you can change your mind.

questions.title: Read your day on Home
questions.summary: Dashboard (Home on the phone): sales today, cash, what is owed and what is low on stock, for the place you choose. Customise picks what shows. On the phone, what needs you comes first, then My day and your weekly digest.

questions.title: Deal with what is waiting on you
questions.summary: Inbox: approvals, mentions, tasks, alerts, messages and missed calls, with one button on each. Approve or decline, reply, mark done, or snooze an item and it comes back later.

questions.title: Approve or decline a request
questions.summary: Open it from your Inbox: it says why it needs you and who else must approve. Approve moves it on; Decline needs a reason the person who asked will read. Approvals shows where your own requests stand, and you can withdraw one that is waiting.

questions.title: Find a customer, a document or a page
questions.summary: Search: type two letters or more and the answers come in groups of customers, documents, pages and messages. On the web, Ctrl or ⌘ K opens Go to page from anywhere.

questions.title: Keep working on the phone without a connection
questions.summary: Phone › Waiting to send: comments, notes, new people, moved deals, expenses and settings made offline are kept and sent by themselves when you are back online. Money, approvals, sending and saving a sale always need a connection.

questions.title: See your day and set up a meeting
questions.summary: Calendar: meetings, bookings and appointments by day, week, month, year or agenda, yours or everyone’s. New meeting takes the time, colleagues and guests; Booking links let a customer pick a free time. On the phone, today’s meetings, calls and tasks are under My day on Home.

questions.title: Send a quotation and turn it into an order
questions.summary: Sell › Quotations › New quotation: pick the customer, add the lines and a valid-until date, then submit it; a discount past your limit waits for a manager. Send the link, record the answer, then make a sales order. The phone does the same, and saving needs a connection.

questions.title: Find a customer and see what they owe
questions.summary: Sell › Customers: everyone you sell to, people and companies, with what each owes and when they last bought. Open one for the statement, documents, activity and credit limit. A new customer that looks like one you have is flagged. On the phone, call, chat app or email from their page.

questions.title: Follow a deal through your pipeline
questions.summary: Sell › Deals: a column for each stage of a pipeline, with what its deals are worth. Choose a deal’s stage or drag it, and add a new deal to any stage. On the phone, move a deal from its row; a lost deal asks why, and a won one offers to make the order.

questions.title: Answer a customer’s ticket
questions.summary: Support › Tickets: what customers raised, who has each one and when the first reply is due. Open one to reply to the customer or leave a note only your team sees, then set its status and press Resolve. On the phone, Mine comes first and Take it assigns a ticket to you.

questions.title: See your cash and bank balances
questions.summary: Money › Financial accounts: every bank, cash and mobile-money account, with the book balance, the bank’s last balance and what is available. Import statements and reconcile them; Transfers moves money between your own accounts. On the phone, Cash shows money available, the last 7 days in and out, and where it is.

questions.title: Check a wallet and move money between wallets
questions.summary: Money › Wallets: the money the wallet service holds for you, wallet by wallet, with what each can spend (its balance less what is held for payments on their way). Move money between your own wallets; above a wallet’s threshold it waits for approval, with the money held. On the phone this works only online, and another currency opens the web.
